title: Michael V. takes comparisons in stride as he continues ‘Family Feud’ hosting
summary: As Michael V. continues to host “Family Feud Philippines” in place of its original host, Dingdong Dantes, he rediscovered the fun of hosting and how to properly deal with criticism on social media…

blocks.text: As Michael V. continues to host “Family Feud Philippines” in place of its original host, Dingdong Dantes, he rediscovered the fun of hosting and how to properly deal with criticism on social media Michael V. admitted that he reads comments on social media and tries to eliminate the negative remarks when asked how he deals with comparisons to Dantes. “Oo [nagbabasa ako ng comments]. Tapos dine-delete ko [‘yung negative] at binablock ko ‘yung mga basher. ‘Yun ang pinakamadali talaga, tsaka pinaka humane sa pag-deal with bashers,” he told select members of the press during a recent set visit.
